content.text: No auto-renewal, renewal term, or price-uplift mechanic exists anywhere in this document; the term is event-based and self-terminating.

input.quote: Section 8.3 Termination. This Agreement will terminate on the earlier to occur of (a) the date upon which the last remaining Receivable is paid in full, settled, sold or written off and any amounts received are applied and (b) the Issuer is terminated under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement.
input.rationale: The RENEWAL rule is not engaged by this Agreement. This is a transfer and servicing agreement within a securitization structure, and its term is event-based rather than a fixed term with renewals: under § 8.3 (p0363) the Agreement terminates automatically on the earlier of payoff/disposition of the last Receivable or termination of the Issuer under the Trust Agreement. Article VIII otherwise contains only Optional Acquisition/Clean-Up Redemption (§ 8.1) and Optional Redemption (§ 8.2) mechanics, which are exit rights, not extensions. Searches for "renew", "automatically" (only the successor-servicer appointment at p0335), extension/successive/initial-term language (only Receivable-level payment extensions and Upgrade Offers), and prior-notice windows return no auto-renewal trigger, no renewal term length, no non-renewal notice window, and no renewal price-uplift provision. There is therefore no renewal lock-in or pricing exposure to cap, and the self-terminating structure operates in our favour, so no redline is warranted. Noted for the record rather than flagged: because there is no renewal mechanic at all, the preferred elements (vendor reminder, opt-out notice, CPI/3% uplift cap) have nothing to attach to; if the parties later add a term-and-renewal construct, the preferred position should be applied then.
